Hello there! 
My profile mostly says everything I have done, which can be considered worthwhile. But my biggest flex is having people I can grow old with. As meaningful relations surpass all forms of achievements. 

I love to travel; I have this bizarre wish to set my footsteps in places rarely anyone would have explored. Also, I love music, any shape or form, it's just wonderful.

Lastly, I love talking! Every person holds such tremendous stories, no less than folklore.
If you want to reach out or discuss literally anything, here's my email: [email protected]

posts.text:
“The best way to predict the future is to create it.”
- Peter Drucker

I deal with clients every day, getting to see firsthand the 100s of different problems they face. Looking at Fibr; few are surprised, few fear it, a few even neglect it, but every single one understands the gap.

The gap between your audience out there, navigating with their Google Maps on (Search, LLMs, Ads, etc.), trying to reach your home (your website)… only to realize they were never really welcome, because it feels different from what they came looking for.

Fibr is bridging this gap for two insanely high-intent audiences → Ads & LLM visitors, by allowing them to experience exactly what pulled them to your website in the first place using Ads-to-Web and LLM-to-Web Personalization.

See the full breakdown of how it works.👇 


(P.S. One of my clients runs 100,000+ keywords on a single landing page. Imagine the gap if that page remains static for every single one of them.)

We raised $7.5 million, yes!! and this is just the beginning.

When I joined Fibr, just fresh out of my college, I was in love with the vision. I had no idea where it would all lead, but I always believed that what we were building was one hell of an innovation, and I’m pretty sure it's going to get much much better from now on.

I am highly grateful for the network and exposure I’ve gained as a lead here, and as an active contributor in the startup ecosystem. Every single person on our team has helped me reach where I am today, and where I’ll go in the future. Especially while contributing to GTM alongside my super-awesome colleagues Owen O'Leary, Porter Sperry and Cody Bean. This one’s for all of us.

Over the last 1.5 years, I’ve learned a lot; from Sales to GTM to Marketing to Product. You never really wear just one hat in a startup, do you? Especially while contributing to GTM alongside my super-awesome colleagues Owen, Porter & Cody

What are we solving for?
- Every team looks at the website differently. Fibr brings them together using AI; aligning experience, performance, governance, and insights through one intelligent system.

I’ve always said this: funding is never the hard part, it’s the propeller for what’s ahead. We have a long way to go and so much more to innovate.

#ai #startups #marketing #martech #gtm

Excited to share that our research paper, “Advanced Encryption Using Generative Adversarial Network for Enhancing Security of Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs),” has just been published in IEEE Access (Volume 13, 2025).

This work explores how GANs can be applied to strengthen encryption for NFTs (Or generic media)

Wouldn’t have been possible without Mr. Arnav Gujarathi, our project leader. I love how we completed this during our 4th year, and now it has finally been published. A big thank you to Dr. Asish Bera, our professor, whose guidance and mentorship played a huge role in shaping this research.

The article is now live on IEEE Xplore:
 🔗 DOI: 10.1109/ACCESS.2025.3603088

#ieee #blockchain #journal #security #bits

So, my team at Fibr AI just created a CRO Game using Lovable, and it’s wild that we pulled this off in a single day. It’s a simple 10-question quiz to test your knowledge of websites & best practices to improve UX.

Would love for everyone to give it a go!
➤ Take the CRO quiz via the link in the comments.
 ➤ Screenshot your score and tag Fibr AI to show off your results!
 ➤ The leaderboard topper wins a $25 cash prize!

P.S. My score’s below 😌

#CROChallenge #FibrAI #PlayAndWin #MarketingFun #ConversionOptimization #GameOn #LetsPlay

"Nothing is more expensive than a missed opportunity."
— H. Jackson Brown Jr.

I took a major risk by leaving a comfortable full-time job to join an early-stage startup. I still remember my first call with Pritam Roy, who motivated me with, "You're in your early 20s, now's the time!"

Today, I’m thrilled to share that I've been promoted to GTM & Sales Lead at Fibr AI 🚀 

Can't thank Ankur (AJ) Goyal enough, for trusting me and my capabilities. The journey has been a tremendous learning curve and a life-changing experience (And, it will continue as the same in future!)

To Touhid Haji and Sarthak Singh — it’s always a pleasure working with you both. Thank you for having my back.
And to Prerana Saha for cheering everyone up with random fun events :-)

With the pace at which Fibr AI is growing, I do believe we are carrying the olympic torch for AI agents in the Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) space. It’s been an exciting journey, and I’m grateful for the opportunity to dive deep into the world of AI.

#AI #artificialintelligence #cro #web #fibr

P.S. Thanks for letting me go on a hike 🗻
